defense_arsenal.activation_rules: Arsenal keys removed from ground loot and vending machines. Unlocked by standing in capture range until 100%.
defense_arsenal.capture_speed: Accelerated with multiple teammates in range. Contested state triggers when enemies enter range, pausing progress.
defense_arsenal.reward: Unlocks arsenal and spawns a scanning UAV above it that reveals nearby enemies. UAV can be destroyed by enemies.

solo_dare.trigger_condition: Available for free in Vending Machines (excluding Airdrop Vending Machines) when all teammates are eliminated in Duo/Squad mode.
solo_dare.completion_reward: 400 FF Coins and Super Revival for all teammates.
solo_dare.visibility: Player location visible to all enemies on mini-map.
solo_dare.eliminator_reward: Mystery gift awarded for eliminating Solo Dare player.

global_map_loot.lv1_war_chest: Reduced high-level items drop rate, increased healing items drop rate

airship_system.mechanics: Patrols along fixed route. Accessible via ziplines.
airship_system.timed_war_chest: Produces new high-tier weapons/items every 120 seconds.

vending_machine_adjustments.revival_card_qol: Auto-selects maximum revived teammates based on available FF Coins.
